name: smwmusic-pizza-tower-hot-spaghetti
title: Pizza Tower - Hot Spaghetti
description:
The song "Hot Spaghetti" from Pizza Tower's Pizzascape level, originally composed by Mr. Sauceman. Might be best for castle levels? To be honest I only really wanted to port this because Pizza Tower just turned 3. Happy birthday, Pizza Tower!

The original samples were found using the Pizza Tower Sound Sheet.
